findings.title: Trailing-slash variants 404 with no redirect
findings.evidence: check:canonical adjacent — /docs 404, /docs/commands 404, /aem/ 404; sitemap+canonicals mixed convention (/aem no slash, docs pages with slash)
findings.businessImpact: Inbound links/typed URLs on the wrong variant hard-404; link equity discarded — on a 4-page site every backlink matters.
findings.fix: 301 each non-canonical variant to its canonical at the edge; better: one convention site-wide, update canonical+sitemap+internal links together.

findings.title: og:type missing on all 4 pages
findings.evidence: rendered DOM: og:title/description/image/url + twitter:card present, og:type null everywhere; docs pages share generic og:image
findings.businessImpact: Spec-incomplete OG; generic share image weakens docs share CTR.
findings.fix: Add og:type=website via head.html/metadata; page-specific og:images for docs.

findings.title: /docs/commands/: prepare-migration section missing its h2

findings.businessImpact: Command not addressable in document outline — cannot rank for its own queries; screen-reader users cannot navigate to it.
findings.fix: Add the /stardust:prepare-migration h2 matching the other seven command sections.
